title: Developers said…2026 Shader Ecosystem Survey Results
subtitle: Khronos releases the 2026 Real-Time Shading Ecosystem Survey Report, a summary of insights from over 400 shader developers, graphics programmers, rendering engineers, and tools creators. Conducted between June 16 and July 10, 2026, the survey captures a clear picture of how the real-time shading community works today — and where standardization efforts can deliver the greatest impact.
